title: Author the lite instruction set for the PR-submit phase (D1-D4)
body:
## Background

Parent roadmap: #1539 (lite-execution-profile). Blocked by #1541 (sync-manifest drift control must exist before this content lands).

`docs/weak-model-lite-profile-design.md` scopes `idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` (D1-D4: rebase, validate, push, open PR, wait for CI) as in-scope: "Mechanical rebase/validate/push/open-PR continuation of the same single issue."

## Proposed change

Author `idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md`, condensing `idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` under this roadmap's five content principles (self-contained checklists, imperative single-clause steps, no deep cross-references, mechanical helper gates as the fail-closed default with an explicit `instructions-only` fallback statement, explicit stop-and-ask conditions). Wire it into `audit/sync-manifest.json`'s `syncPairs` and generate the `.github/instructions/lite/` copy.

**Non-goal**: no semantic changes to the standard profile.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md` exists, covering D1-D4, self-contained per principle 1.
- [ ] The generated `.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md` copy exists and matches its `syncPairs` entry.
- [ ] The lite file fits within its assigned `bundleBudgets` byte ceiling.
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.
- [ ] A reviewer confirms no semantic disagreement with `idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` (recorded in the PR description).

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable; below the configured floor is human-oriented._
